reviews.title: Agree with others. Used to be excellent
reviews.text: Used to be my go-to app for most activities and loved so much about it, but I finally cancelled my subscription because the app isn’t keeping up with iOS updates. Constantly need to restart watch or phone to get a proper and inconsistently reliable connection. HR capture variable. Just a struggle. Would love to return to the app but can’t trust it anymore.

reviews.title: Crashes and loses workout
reviews.text: Shows promise but it’s not the best app, and additionally they have crashes on the latest watchOS which means you can’t end your workout and you’ll lose the whole run.

reviews.title: Used to be Great, doesn’t work now
reviews.text: Was a great app and when it works it still is but I run with an Apple Watch and now every run the app freezes and workouts aren’t recorded. It’s incredibly unfortunate since it was such a good app and now I can’t even use it. On the odd occasion it does work it still records everything and is excellent but it’s is always a risk so I barely use it anymore.
